"""Helper utilities."""
import re

def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title to a slug: lowercase, collapsed non-alphanumeric, trimmed."""
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = title.lower()
    # Replace non-alphanumeric characters with underscores
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '_', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing underscores
    return text.strip('_')
